series.planningFocusEn: Explain the real placement footprint, support or mounting relationship, operating clearance and environmental scale. Use room, entryway, floor or stepped placements only where appropriate to the SKU. For one sold unit, separate alternative-placement views and keep styling objects clearly outside sale contents.

rigid.title: 刚性结构
rigid.promptEn: Preserve fixed width, depth, wall thickness and component alignment. Choose a supported view revealing the primary face and one depth cue; use actual openings and joins as identity landmarks. Move the camera or adjust whitespace to fit the layout, keeping the object geometry unchanged.

soft.title: 柔性织物
soft.promptEn: Preserve the cut, seams, hems, print placement and real thickness. Show gravity-driven folds and supported drape from actual contact points; retain seam continuity across folds. Choose a flat, folded or in-use state supported by the source rather than imposing a rigid silhouette.

flat.title: 平面与印刷品
flat.promptEn: Keep the actual aspect ratio, trim, border widths and print orientation. Use a near-parallel view when artwork is the buyer focus; reveal thickness only through a supported edge view. Preserve exact printed marks from a readable source and distinguish them from added advertising copy.

packaged.title: 包装与内容物
packaged.promptEn: Lock the real package version, closure, label face and declared sale unit. Choose closed or open presentation from available evidence; an open view must show verified contents and genuine boundary overlaps. Separate packaging, contents and repeated explanatory views so quantity remains unambiguous.

multipart.title: 组件与套装
multipart.promptEn: Map the principal item and each verified included part before arranging them. Keep independent outlines and actual connection points readable; choose an assembled view or a countable contents layout according to the task. Use an exploded or step view only with supported geometry and a resolved design choice.

handheld.title: 手持与操作
handheld.promptEn: Show the actual supported grip, with fingers contacting the documented handling area and the working feature visible. Preserve product-to-hand scale and the chosen action state; keep wrist and part orientations physically coherent. Hand presence demonstrates the selected use, not unverified ergonomic or weight claims.

mounted.title: 安装与悬挂
mounted.promptEn: Keep the actual bracket, fastener or suspension path continuous and visible where the task requires it. Show a compatible receiving surface, real wall offset and documented operating clearance. Place cast shadows on receiving surfaces and distinguish supplied mounting parts from contextual fixtures.

elongated.title: 细长与横展
elongated.promptEn: Preserve true length, cross-section and end fittings. Choose a supported camera angle that shows both ends with limited foreshortening; let long edges follow one coherent perspective. Use the frame direction and whitespace for balance rather than shortening or bending a rigid object.

matte.title: 哑光
matte.promptEn: On the identified matte region, use broad soft brightness gradients and restrained diffuse highlights. Retain actual surface variation and readable turning planes without adding a glossy reflection or synthetic grain.

glossy.title: 亮面
glossy.promptEn: On the identified glossy region, shape a clean broad source reflection that follows its curvature. Keep printed marks readable and avoid clipped streaks; surrounding matte parts retain their own diffuse response.

metal.title: 金属
metal.promptEn: Apply metallic reflection only to the evidenced metal region. Preserve its actual brushed, polished or coated finish; use controlled light-to-dark reflected bands to explain shape, retaining documented grain direction without turning every surface into chrome.

transparent.title: 透明与半透明
transparent.promptEn: For the evidenced transparent region, retain real edge thickness, layered boundaries and supported transmission. Let the background remain visible through it with plausible distortion; avoid opaque white fill, empty invisible edges or unverified colored glow.

textile.title: 织物
textile.promptEn: On the evidenced textile region, use gentle oblique light to reveal actual folds, weave scale and seams. Keep prints continuous with the fabric surface; show only texture resolved by the source and preserve genuine thickness rather than adding plushness.

printed.title: 印刷表面
printed.promptEn: Preserve actual artwork placement, color relationships and readable source lettering on the printed region. Let the print follow the supported surface curvature and illumination; keep added scene copy separate from physical labels.
